title: Civil action.
bodyText: Nothing in this chapter shall prohibit the bringing of a civil action against a motor vehicle repair dealer, mechanic, or apprentice by an individual.
bodyHtml: [§437B-21]  Civil action.  Nothing in this chapter shall prohibit the bringing of a civil action against a motor vehicle repair dealer, mechanic, or apprentice by an individual. [L 1975, c 143, pt of §2]
